brief:
Israeli forces conducted raids across several Palestinian areas in the occupied West Bank on Sunday evening, distributing notices ordering construction halts and home demolitions, Shehab Wire reported. The military sweeps targeted multiple locations throughout the territory.

The operations disrupted Palestinian civilian movement through a checkpoint positioned north of Jerusalem, creating additional obstacles to transit in the region. Military incursions of this scale typically involve house-to-house searches and the issuance of administrative orders affecting property ownership and use.
